newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan king pardons 576 prisoners on eve of Eid.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan king pardons 576 prisoners on eve of Eid.

text.p: King Hassan of Morocco pardoned 576 prisoners on Saturday, the eve of celebrations marking the start of the Eid al-Fitr feast, the Moroccan RTM television said.
RTM did not say if political prisoners were among those freed. More than 50 political prisoners, most of them Moslem fundamentalists, are in the country's prisons.
Morocco will celebrate the start of the Eid on Sunday, marking the end of the fasting holy month of Ramadan.
